caption: The drawing depicts a single elongated object that is curved and tapers to a point on one end. The object appears to be a sheath or scabbard, colored primarily green with an intricate decorative pattern along its length. The pattern consists of interwoven, scrolling acanthus leaves and vines rendered in a rich yellow-gold hue. The green surface serves as the background for the gold decoration. The object is centrally placed on a plain, light beige background, with no other figures or items present in the composition.
title: Woodcarving from Ship's Bow
